card.name: Technical documentation and code text
card.fires_on: Single words inside technical manuals and code, such as Linux man-page headers and footers, SQL table definitions, and section cross-references. It is not tied to one word.

modes.label: Linux man pages
modes.description: Words in man-page title lines, section headings and the colophon footer.

modes.label: SQL table definitions
modes.description: The word auto before _increment in CREATE TABLE statements.

modes.label: Cross-references and verse numbers
modes.description: Words or punctuation in references to a section number or a verse.

card.plain: It fires on words in computer manuals and database code, not on medical text.
